what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Uganda.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 644537 in Uganda, 54.8% of all refugees from the country and more than in any other host country.
Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in many periods since 1964, at war level in several years including 2017 and 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the groups fighting the government include M23, the AFC and the CNPSC, among others.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Uganda rose from 34000 in 1964 to 644537 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025; the figure also changed sharply in most years from 1990 to 1998.
Returns from Uganda were highest in 2009 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Uganda only.
People displaced inside the Democratic Republic of the Congo are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Uganda they live.
